# Building Permit Processing Agent — Delivery Runbook

## Prerequisites

| Recipe prerequisite | Recorded requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Copilot Studio plugin | mcs-assistant@copilot-studio-plugin |
| Minimum PAC CLI version | 2.9.3 |
| Authoring mode | cli-copilot |
| Portable tool to verify | BuildingPermitProcessingAgent |
| Build workload | 24 captured manual build steps · 7 skills · 2 knowledge files · 5 acceptance checks · 5 locked cases |

### Delivery prerequisites

| Requirement | Confirm before building |
| --- | --- |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm licensing for your tenant and Copilot Credits for building and testing the GitHub Copilot harness agent; do not assume the unpublished permit workshop is free to run. |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved permit environment, publisher prefix and maker access. Confirm the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available without changing the workshop's Draft boundary. |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review uploaded permit documents, proposed Dynamics 365 Customer Service, SharePoint and Microsoft Teams access, and channel restrictions; document rather than bypass blocked paths. |
| Identity and audience | Review GroupMembership access, Integrated authentication and the Always authentication trigger in the supplied settings; name the maker, staff audience and production access approver. |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for permit records, plan documents and field coordination. Record dedicated target-environment references and read-only identities; leave live connections out of the workshop. |
| Test identities | Prepare technician, reviewer, inspector and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment. Makers use Draft Preview; sharing must not become a reason to publish the workshop. |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane uses the Copilot Studio browser and reviewed uploads. Easy mode requires VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer. |
| Municipal rule ownership | Have the permit owner approve real intake, review clocks, fee schedules and inspection-review responsibilities before replacing the fixed fictional records and rules. |

### Delivery roles

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Permit service owner | Approve intake, review-clock and escalation rules and production success measures; distinguish recommendations from authorized municipal decisions. |
| Plan reviewers and inspection lead | Review checklist scope, routing and coverage recommendations; retain permit, compliance and inspection decisions instead of delegating them to the synthetic agent. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Preserve the fixed snapshot, reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and all seven skills; capture the actual inspector-skill validation outcome and keep the build Draft. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm tenant licensing, capacity, environment access, authenticated audience and data policies before production permit integrations are enabled. |
| Municipal connection owners | Approve dedicated Dynamics 365 Customer Service, SharePoint and Microsoft Teams references, their identities and read-only access; own connection failures and replacements. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check BPP-01 through BPP-05 and refusal tests on the current Draft; reject historical published-pilot, blank and reshoot-required images as current proof. |
| Operations owner | Own production session and credit monitoring, support and configuration recovery; escalate permit, fee and inspection decisions to the responsible human reviewers. |

### Connections to qualify, not assumed live

- Dynamics 365 Customer Service
- SharePoint
- Microsoft Teams

### Completion boundary

Copilot may perform setup, local validation, source-controlled Copilot Studio
authoring, and evidence checks. It must stop at **Draft**. Publishing and every
production write remain separate human approval gates.

### Source-controlled lane checklist (catalog easy_mode)

This catalog checklist describes source-controlled delivery, including future connection work. The package's synthetic-data and Draft-only boundaries still apply.

- [ ] Verify Power Platform CLI 2.9.3 or newer and authenticate to the target environment.
- [ ] Use the Copilot Studio plugin initialization workflow to create a modern, sync-connected agent project with an approved publisher prefix.
- [ ] Give the Copilot Studio Architect this blueprint and the initialized project so it writes the modern instructions, skills, and tools as YAML.
- [ ] Bind Dynamics 365 Customer Service, SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams connections through dedicated connection references.
- [ ] Use the Copilot Studio Manage workflow to run pac copilot push, then validate the three canned prompts before publishing.

### Recipe-specific authoring prompt

Catalog reference for the source-controlled lane; retain the Draft-only completion boundary above.

```text
You are GitHub Copilot running in Agent mode in VS Code with the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin installed. Promote the AI BAST Building Permit Processing Agent using this deployment recipe: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library/main/solutions/building-permit-processing/deployment.json. Own every command and file change; do not ask me to use a terminal. Ask me only for the target Power Platform environment ID and publisher prefix. Verify PAC CLI is at least 2.9.3, authenticate if needed, initialize a new cli-copilot project, and use the Copilot Studio Architect workflow to author modern YAML that preserves permit_backlog, intake_triage, applicant_updates, and inspector_assignment. Create or bind dedicated Dynamics 365 Customer Service, SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams connection references, review every generated YAML file and connection, pull before push, run pac copilot push, and replay the three recipe acceptance prompts. Stop before publish and show me the generated files, validation evidence, unresolved connection work, and the exact publish command that would make it live.
```

**Exit criteria**

- [ ] The maker has authenticated to the approved environment and preserved the initialized cli-copilot identity and settings.
- [ ] The pushed Draft contains the reviewed instructions, two synthetic knowledge files and all seven skills, with the reviewed model and no live municipal connections.
- [ ] BPP-01 through BPP-05 pass final-response checks in target Preview; an abbreviated demo does not satisfy the five-case acceptance corpus.
- [ ] The reviewer has recorded the current release agent, environment, model, inventory and `published: false`; historical pilot publication is not release approval.

## Phase 2 — Optional Brainstem Track

Brainstem is the learner's personal, on-device training AI. It works alongside

Copilot remains the familiar work surface.

Then send these two short messages:

### 2. Build and test the solution

```text
Give me Building Permit Processing using Easy Mode and test it for me.
```

### 3. Deploy the validated Draft

```text
Deploy it into Copilot Studio for me.
```

### What pulls the harness

1. The attached skill starts the installed Brainstem, finds
   `@aibast-agents-library/workshop` in the AIBAST registry, and imports it
   through `/agents/import`.
2. `AIBASTWorkshopAgent` resolves the named solution from `registry.json`,
   retrieves its standard package, and hot-loads and tests the business agent.
3. The same generic engine remembers the active solution, so “Deploy it” runs
   the validated Draft flow without the attendee repeating URLs or context.
4. Copilot executes any real front-door handoff returned by Brainstem, sends
   the captured Preview evidence back, and continues until Brainstem returns
   `status: complete`.
5. The final gate requires **Draft** and `published: false`.

Generic workshop engine: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library/main/agents/@aibast-agents-library/templates/workshop_agent.py

The person sets the destination and reads the
verdict; Brainstem + Copilot pull the harness.

## Phase 4 — Acceptance

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** expected names, identifiers, and figures below are fictional test evidence, not customer results.

- [ ] settings.mcs.yml exists and preserves the initialized identity, environment binding, language, and authoring mode.
- [ ] Every advertised permit capability is represented by instructions, a skill, or a bound tool.
- [ ] Connection references point to dedicated, connected records in the target environment.
- [ ] The backlog, intake, routing, communication, and inspection demo prompts produce the expected entities and actions.
- [ ] Publishing remains a separate, user-approved step after push and validation.

### Deployment smoke test

| Check | Expected value |
| --- | --- |
| Prompt | Which permit applications have been sitting too long, and which resident is going to complain first? |
| Must call | BuildingPermitProcessingAgent |
| Must include | BP-2025-0104; Metro School District |

### Package evidence gates

From [FIELD-GUIDE.md — Evidence gates](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md#evidence-gates):

- **Source gate:** deployment source and isolated transcripts exist.
- **Easy gate:** available Easy evidence identifies the agent, environment,
  model, inventory, cases, and Draft state.
- **Manual gate:** manual evidence passes, every browserfilm frame exists, and
  the tutorial maps one action to each frame.
- **Parity gate:** Easy and Manual use the reviewed instructions, knowledge,
  skills, model, and case identifiers.
- **Draft gate:** the package records `published: false`; publication is not
  part of scaffolding.
- **Customer gate:** replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support,
  and success measures are agreed before production.

### Go / no-go

| Criterion | Required threshold |
| --- | --- |
| Locked permit corpus | Require all five cases, BPP-01 through BPP-05, to satisfy every required and forbidden marker. Passing an abbreviated set is no-go for acceptance. |
| Full workflow inventory | Require two knowledge files and all seven skills, including permit status, review checklist and fee calculation, with reviewed instructions and matching Easy/Manual model. |
| Backlog contract | BPP-01 must reproduce only the locked response and its municipal-system footer. Added issue, send or assignment directives, or current-date recalculation, are no-go. |
| Inspector-skill validation | Complete the checkpoint only when inspector-board-and-coverage is accepted and visible. A retry is required only after a genuine recorded error; historical retry images are not current proof. |
| Municipal authority boundary | Any permit write, applicant message, inspection booking, fee transaction, invented live lookup or compliance certification fails the boundary gate. |
| Visual evidence | Use current-agent captures with visible target-state anchors. Withhold blank, historical published-pilot and reshoot-required images; recapture before claiming those steps are proven. |
| Source evidence and Draft release | Require source, isolated transcripts and the same-corpus Copilot Studio replay for the current Draft with `published: false`; a historical Preview pass does not authorize publication. |
| Production decision | No-go until approved read-only connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures are agreed. Any write needs separate human approval; workshop proof is not production approval. |

**Exit criteria**

- [ ] The acceptance reviewer has recorded all five locked results against their exact assertions and canonical transcripts, including BPP-01's action and date prohibitions.
- [ ] The boundary tests preserve recommendation-only output, fixed dates, unknown-record handling and the bans on permit changes, messages, inspection actions and fee transactions.
- [ ] Easy and Manual inputs and model match; current inspector validation is evidenced, and reusable, historical and reshoot-required captures remain distinguishable.
- [ ] The reviewed release agent is Draft with `published: false`; no workshop result is presented as live municipal access, code compliance or publication approval.

## Phase 5 — Production Hardening

| Area | Owner and action |
| --- | --- |
| Identity and audience | Administrator: scope technician, reviewer and inspector access and test a denied identity in a separately approved test deployment. Preserve the workshop's authenticated, Draft-only boundary. |
| DLP and data handling | Administrator: approve permit-document, Dynamics 365 Customer Service, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams and channel policies; test blocked paths and keep real applicant details out of public evidence. |
| ALM | Maker: version the fixed policy, two knowledge files, seven skills and model together. Preserve sync identity, pull before push, package with `pac copilot pack` and replay all five locked cases. |
| Telemetry and support | After approved release, the operator reviews failed or rejected Monitor sessions, wrong-permit answers, tool authentication errors and credit usage; route rule defects to the permit owner. |
| Rollback | Operator: reapply retained, known-good permit files in a test workspace, pull before push and replay five cases plus boundary tests; obtain separate approval before restoring production access. |
| Connection ownership | Record owners, identities and dedicated references for Dynamics 365 Customer Service records, SharePoint plans and Microsoft Teams coordination; start approved connections read-only. |
| Human authorization | Permit, inspection and finance owners must approve any future write design separately. Keep updates as drafts and fees as estimates until governance and explicit human authorization are in place. |

### Production replacement seams

From [FIELD-GUIDE.md — Production replacement seams](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md#production-replacement-seams):

- Replace packaged synthetic inputs with an approved Dynamics 365 Customer Service connection; preserve the reviewed input and output contract.
- Replace packaged synthetic inputs with an approved SharePoint connection; preserve the reviewed input and output contract.
- Replace packaged synthetic inputs with an approved Microsoft Teams connection; preserve the reviewed input and output contract.

The pilot must never claim a side effect, live lookup, or system update unless
an approved production tool returns evidence that it succeeded.

### Package production policy

From [GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md — Production seams](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md#production-seams):

A production implementation can replace the packaged permit records with
Dynamics 365 Customer Service, plan and policy documents with SharePoint, and
notifications or field coordination with Microsoft Teams-backed tools. These
are future integration seams only; no live connector is configured. Start any
approved production connection in read-only mode. Keep external writes disabled
until they pass separate governance review and require explicit human approval.

Review the [architecture seams](2.Architecture.md#production-replacement-seams) and the [customer gate](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md#evidence-gates) before changing data sources or enabling writes; workshop acceptance is not production approval.

**Exit criteria**

- [ ] Owners have approved read-only permit records in Dynamics 365 Customer Service, plan and policy documents in SharePoint, and coordination through Microsoft Teams.
- [ ] Identity, source permissions and data policies pass allowed-user and denied-user checks in a separately approved test deployment; the workshop remains Draft.
- [ ] The operator has agreed telemetry, support and success measures and rehearsed recovery of a known-good permit configuration.
- [ ] The five-case synthetic regression pack and refusal tests pass after configuration changes; writes and publication remain separate, explicit human approvals.

## Failure Recovery

From [FIELD-GUIDE.md — Failure recovery](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md#failure-recovery):

| Symptom | Recovery |
| --- | --- |
| A required evidence file is missing | Stop. Capture or restore the real file; never substitute a mockup. |
| A browser frame disagrees with the tutorial | Treat the frame and evidence JSON as authoritative, correct the package metadata, and regenerate. |
| Knowledge is still processing | Wait for ingestion to finish before Preview; do not interpret a partial answer as evidence. |
| A skill upload fails | Download the linked raw `SKILL.md`, correct the reviewed source if necessary, and retry visibly. |
| Easy and Manual inventories differ | Stop the comparison and restore exact instruction, knowledge, skill, and model parity. |
| A recorded identifier is absent | Mark the case failed and investigate; do not retry until it happens to pass. |
| Publish is offered | Stop at Draft unless a separate approver explicitly authorizes publication. |

## Deliverables Checklist

- [ ] Every advertised one-pager capability maps to implemented behavior.
- [ ] The synthetic data contains the customer problem the slide describes.
- [ ] Persona-language prompts route to the agent in an isolated Brainstem.
- [ ] The deterministic output proves the expected entities and decisions.
- [ ] Canonical transcripts are captured from those exact live runs.
- [ ] Static demos render the captured transcripts rather than invented replies.
- [ ] Copilot Studio replays the same corpus before publishing.

Source: [seven-step release gate](../../solutions/README.md#release-gate). Record fresh evidence against each check; this list is not a claim that the checks passed.
